name: collect smooth relations, then combine them into a square
mechanism: find many numbers whose squares modulo the target factor completely over a small prime base, record each exponent vector modulo two, find a linear dependency among the vectors to multiply a subset into a perfect square on both sides, and take a greatest common divisor to split the target
